question: Does the control-derived gen1 datum close with the measured DoD on stable open ground?

inputs.role: adopted gen1 surface offsets at this site
gen2's datum on its DELIVERED surface, open ground

params.name: geoid_mm
params.why: references.geoid_difference over elbaext; the GEOID03->GEOID18 term the pipeline ADDS to gen1, which is why it does not cancel between c1 and c2

params.name: measured_dod_mm
params.why: median of dod_geoid.npy on stable AND open cells, 116,507 cells

columns.value_mm: millimetres; positive = the surface reads LOW, so ADD it

headline: closure miss 0.0050 mm; DoD absolute correction +2.12 mm
